scope: Generated bounded DWG FIELD CadValue transport for type 0 under R2007+ low-format-flag suppression. The value remains semantically unknown; generated transport tests do not establish FIELD evaluation or complete-source output support.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.rule: R2007+ stores Flags as BL code 93 followed by Data type as BL code 90. ODA says Flags & 0x01 marks the general type and that the type-specific variant is absent when bit 1 in Flags is set. The implementation suppresses FIELD CadValue payload for low flag bits per the LibreDWG master implementation; this does not resolve physical FIELD suffixes or native meaning.

corroboratingImplementation.rule: LibreDWG master reads format_flags and data_type, then skips the type-specific switch for R2007+ when (format_flags & 3) is nonzero. The local AC1021 sample has flags=2/type=2 checksum children with 34-bit body suffixes under this interpretation; treat this peer rule as a differential, not normative or semantic proof.

behavior: Accept a bounded type-0 value when its recognized R2007+ FIELD flags suppress the payload.
Retain the type, flags, unit/format metadata, surrounding FIELD value string and following stream alignment without inventing an application value.
Permit DWG re-encoding only when the absent-payload value has no variant, raw bytes, data size or object handle.
Keep unsupported flags, unknown nonzero data types and malformed extra payload state refused.
Keep TABLE CadValue payload handling separate: the local AC1021 TABLE source profile carries flags=2/type=2 checksum values, so this FIELD-only change does not alter TABLE payload presence.
implementation.fixturePolicy: Coverage uses generated in-memory vectors. No DWG or DXF fixture was added or committed.

coverage: Generated FIELD flags 1/2/3 payload suppression, metadata alignment, scalar absence and object-ID handle-slot absence.
TABLE flags=2 retained payload and handle behavior remain covered separately.

planEffect: Closes only generated type-0 suppressed transport. It does not close the physical flags=2 checksum-child suffix, the physical AcObjProp schemas, or native FIELD semantics. P5 remains OPEN and no support claim is promoted.
